name: André
bio: One of two people Wilde reported meeting on a three-day trip to Nice with Harold Mellor in January 1899, while Wilde was staying at La Napoule on the Riviera. Wilde described him to Robert Ross as 'one beautiful person, called André, with wonderful eyes'. No surname, age, occupation, dates or further trace appear in the letter, and nothing else about him was found in the pages read.
bio_note: Sole source: Wilde to Robert Ross, Thursday [? 12 January 1899], Napoule, Complete Letters (2000), p. 1118 (PDF 1164, printed folio confirmed on the rendered page image). the collective mentions on the same tier (the Riviera fishing population, the Napoule fisher-lads) name no individual and stay in the collective entry on Wilde's record. Dates: none recorded. Searched so far: the whole OCR mirror of the Complete Letters (2000) for every occurrence of the name, plus the edition's General Index; Frankel, Oscar Wilde: The Unrepentant Years (2017), PDF, the fullest scholarly account of the exile years; McKenna, The Secret Life of Oscar Wilde (2008) and Murray, Bosie (2020), PDFs. Frankel treats the Nice trip at printed p. 245 (PDF 259) and names 'two young men named André and Pietro, the former "with wonderful eyes"' without adding anything the letter does not already say. No birth or death date is recorded in any source consulted, and none is likely to be: the record preserves a first name (or a trade) in another man's correspondence and no surname to search by.
